case: If you believe two healthy starters today beat waiting on Walker's groin, this trade is worth sending. The chart is missing this week, so this one rests on your gut and the sheet, not a value number. Walker is the RB3 and the best player in the deal, and he is reported to be close to a return, so the risk is that you sell a star right before he comes back. His history says he fades after midseason, though, while Tuten gives you another RB who can play now and Higgins is the WR7 on a strong offense. With byes hitting your starters this week and your team on the bubble, that depth is the push I'd make.

sides.reason: Bo Girds gets a healthy starting RB and a top WR for an injured star.
Teehee gets the RB3 in Walker, betting his absence is short.
